title: Protein Folding Viewer with Save/Load State
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D protein folding viewer using Three.js in a single HTML file. The viewer should simulate a simplified protein backbone as a chain of amino acid residues connected by bonds.

## Scene Setup
- Use a dark background (0x1a1a2e).
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (5, 10, 7) with intensity 0.8.
- Camera at position (0, 0, 40) looking at origin, perspective with FOV 60.
- OrbitControls for mouse rotation/zoom of the entire protein.

## Protein Model
- Generate a chain of 20 amino acid residues represented as spheres (radius 0.5).
- Each residue is colored by type: hydrophobic (red, 0xff4444), hydrophilic (blue, 0x4444ff), neutral (green, 0x44ff44). Assign types cyclically: residues 0,3,6,9,12,15,18 are hydrophobic; 1,4,7,10,13,16,19 are hydrophilic; 2,5,8,11,14,17 are neutral.
- Connect consecutive residues with cylinder bonds (radius 0.1, white color 0xcccccc).
- Initial configuration: residues placed in a straight line along the X-axis, spaced 2.0 units apart, centered at origin. So residue 0 at x=-19, residue 1 at x=-17, ..., residue 19 at x=19.

## Folding Simulation
- Add a 'Fold' button (id='foldBtn') that triggers an animated folding. When clicked, residues should animate over 2 seconds into a compact alpha-helix-like spiral: residue i goes to position (3*cos(i*0.6), i*0.8 - 8, 3*sin(i*0.6)). Bonds update accordingly.
- Add an 'Unfold' button (id='unfoldBtn') that animates residues back to the straight line over 2 seconds.
- Track folding state: 'unfolded', 'folding', 'folded', 'unfolding'.

## Selection
- Implement raycasting: clicking on a residue sphere selects it. Selected residue gets an emissive glow (emissive color 0xffff00, emissiveIntensity 0.5). Only one residue selected at a time. Clicking empty space deselects.
- Display selected residue info in a HUD panel (id='infoPanel') showing: residue index, type (hydrophobic/hydrophilic/neutral), and current position (x,y,z rounded to 1 decimal).

## Energy Display
- Calculate a simplified 'energy' score: sum of (1/distance) for all pairs of hydrophobic residues. Display this in a HUD element (id='energyDisplay') updated whenever positions change. Format: 'Energy: X.XXX'.

## Save/Load State
- Add a 'Save State' button (id='saveBtn') that saves the current positions of all 20 residues and the folding state to localStorage under key 'proteinState'. Also store in window.__3D_STATE__.savedState.
- Add a 'Load State' button (id='loadBtn') that loads from localStorage and animates residues to saved positions over 1 second.
- Add a 'Reset' button (id='resetBtn') that returns to initial straight-line configuration.

## Keyboard Controls
- Press 'H' to toggle visibility of hydrophobic residues.
- Press 'Space' to toggle auto-rotation of the scene (OrbitControls autoRotate).

## HUD/UI
- All buttons styled at top-left, stacked vertically, with dark semi-transparent background, white text, padding 8px 16px, margin 4px.
- Info panel at top-right showing selected residue info.
- Energy display below info panel.
- A residue count label (id='residueCount') showing 'Residues: 20'.

## State Management (window.__3D_STATE__)
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__:
- `residueCount`: number (20)
- `foldingState`: string ('unfolded'|'folding'|'folded'|'unfolding')
- `selectedResidue`: number or null (index of selected residue)
- `energy`: number (current energy value)
- `hydrophobicVisible`: boolean (true initially)
- `autoRotate`: boolean (false initially)
- `savedState`: object or null (last saved state with positions array and foldingState)
- `residuePositions`: array of {x,y,z} for all 20 residues
- `residueTypes`: array of strings ('hydrophobic','hydrophilic','neutral') for all 20
- `getResiduePosition(i)`: function returning {x,y,z} of residue i
- `getEnergy()`: function returning current energy value
physics_constraints: Residues must maintain valid 3D positions (no NaN/Infinity). Bond connections must update when residues move. Energy calculation must be consistent with hydrophobic residue positions. Folding/unfolding animations must complete fully before allowing the opposite action.
